verdict.rationale: PayPal's first-party docs cover every element of the story. Invoicing lets merchants create and send itemized invoices paid through a secure hosted PayPal payment page. Invoices can be shared by URL, branded email, or QR code, and merchants can configure automatic payment reminders. The Invoicing REST API and agent tools (send_invoice, send_invoice_reminder) corroborate this. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of invoicing and automatic reminders in practice.
